en.title: Which clock runs out first?

items.text: Ends early if your licence expires first

en.alt: Diagram comparing three document validity periods: passport usually 10 years, driving licence varies by country, and international driving permit 1 year or up to 3, cut short if the licence expires first, so the shortest one decides
en.caption: Three documents, three clocks. The permit is capped by whichever runs out first.
